# AuditISA

AuditISA is a multi-tenant statutory-audit platform for audit firms working
under ISA and OHADA/SYSCOHADA requirements (bilingual English/French, FCFA).
It supports the full audit lifecycle: acceptance, risk assessment (SCOTs,
WCGWs, combined risk assessment), controls testing, substantive procedures,
misstatement evaluation (SAD), conclusion and archiving.

All engagement data is private and requires authentication; there is no
public content beyond this description and the sign-in page. Please do not
crawl or index application routes.

Contact: https://www.auditisa.com
